description: This file defines an interface for retry filters used in client connection logic within Orleans, along with a specific implementation that employs linear backoff for retry attempts when connecting to a cluster. It contains the interface IClientConnectionRetryFilter and a class LinearBackoffClientConnectionRetryFilter implementing retry logic based on exception types and retry counts.

classes.name: LinearBackoffClientConnectionRetryFilter
classes.description: An internal sealed class implementing a retry filter with linear backoff strategy for reconnecting to the Orleans cluster.

methods.name: ShouldRetryConnectionAttempt
methods.description: Determines whether an attempt to reconnect should be retried based on exception type, retry count, and cancellation token.
